purpose: Repeat of round-1 A-C repulsive at r0=1.5 under the round-3 protocol (T=0.4, tracker only). Round-1/2 fits gave factor 0.85 at 1.5; round-3 A-A/B-B/C-C/A-B gave ~0.55 under the same protocol. Decision: ratio within 0.1 of 0.85 -> round-1 value stands; within 0.1 of 0.55 -> round-3 value applies to A-C too.
